gloss_en: Kelipat Nogah (קְלִפַּת נֹגַהּ) — the 'glowing husk,' the intermediate kabbalistic shell of Nogah (Ezekiel 1:4, 'and a brightness [nogah] around it'), which in LM II:12 is the kelipah that twists and encircles the heart with confusions (bechinat 'libi secharchar'), linked to the realm of Targum
